name: Grain Frame
description: A frame of slowly drifting colour under a fine layer of grain, used as a living border or a full background.

props.name: children
props.description: Content placed over the colour. Give it its own surface and a few pixels of container padding to leave only a border showing.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours of the three drifting patches, and of the gradient beneath them.

props.name: noiseIntensity
props.description: Opacity of the grain, from 0 to 1. It is blended as an overlay, so it reads softer than the number suggests.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed. At 0.1 a patch takes about 20 seconds to circle once.

props.name: animating
props.description: Let the colour drift. It holds still under reduced motion.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blur what shows through the content wrapper, for children with a translucent surface.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the content wrapper, a one-cell grid that stretches its child.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer frame: radius, padding and size. Other div props go to the frame.
